feedback: Written before this robot races. The best raced design is ±0.03 m at 16 mm with y = 0.04 (iteration 3, 69.46, reproduced in iterations 5 to 7). Iteration 4 widened the row to ±0.04 m and cut kp from 1.2 to 1.0 together, scoring 61.49, with progress down on the s-bend (0.210 to 0.160) and oval (0.184 to 0.170). The gain change is the likely cause, but the ±0.04 m row has not been tested at kp 1.2 alone. I have built the controller for that isolating test: kp 1.2, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.1, with the weights unchanged. Do not expect a new best score from this race. The wider row lowers the steering slope per metre, so kp 1.2 may steer somewhat softer than iteration 3. Read line loss and s-bend progress for the ±0.04 m row, and whether line loss stays at 1.0 or more per run. Off-track at about 0.06 m remains the binding failure in every race so far (iterations 0 to 7).
requested_changes: Hold the ±0.04 m row at 16 mm with y = 0.04 (sensor_positions at x = -0.04 to 0.04 in 0.02 m steps) for the next race, because the isolating test needs it unchanged.

If line loss stays at 1.0 or more per run with ±0.04 m at kp 1.2, try sensor_size 0.012 at the same ±0.04 m positions, to test whether 16 mm edge noise is adding s-bend oscillation (iteration 3 s-bend oscillation was 0.168).
Keep y = 0.04 unless slalom steering oscillation reaches 0.15 or more; it has stayed between 0.145 and 0.147 across all row tests.
